newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar, sterling.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling down on dollar, sterling.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling fell slightly against the dollar and sterling on Wednesday but the Central Bank of Tanzania said the depreciation caused no market concern.

The shilling's commercial mean rate was quoted at 601.6230 to the dollar, compared with Tuesday's 601.3260. Against sterling, the shilling was 983.9575, down from Tuesday's 981.9386. -- Nairobi Newsroom ++ 254 2 330261
